thread:
Keisha (Support): Heads-up — KitePilot hit a 403 during SSO provisioning this morning, blocking account activation. Renewal review in 10 days, customer is frustrated. Escalating to CS for priority handoff.
Lina (Customer Success): Ack, thanks Keisha. Can you paste the error/logs and customer contact we should use?
Keisha (Support): Paste from authproxy:
```
2024-05-22T09:41:12Z authproxy ERROR tenant=kitepilot code=403 detail="idp_token_invalid" user_email=j.doe@kitepilot.ai
```
Customer said they saw "permission denied" in the admin UI. Primary contact is Jordan Cole (ops). Said they "need this live by next week" in the last call.
DevOps Bot: Automated alert: authproxy-sso service returned 5 occurrences of code 403 in 7m for tenant=kitepilot. Incident ticket #INC-4821 created.
Ben (Onboarding Eng): Short-term workaround: we can create a temporary service account and complete onboarding flow while we rotate their IdP cert. Command to generate temp key (ops-only):
```
redwoodctl keys create --tenant=kitepilot --scope=onboard --ttl=24h
```
Will need DevOps to approve rotation.
Ethan (Account Exec): KitePilot is a strategic mid-market account — renewal calls scheduled with VP Eng. Need a clear comms plan and timeline to share with customer.
Lina (Customer Success): Draft comms plan (high level):
• Immediate: acknowledge, apology, and temporary workaround offer (temp key) — target: within 2 hours.
• Short term: rotate IdP cert + verify provisioning — target: 24h.
• Follow-up: handoff to success manager, proactive check-in before renewal meeting + usage readout — target: 7 days.
Can @Ben confirm the temp-key flow and estimated ops time?
Ben (Onboarding Eng): Confirmed — temp key creation ~5 min, full IdP cert rotation depends on customer (they control IdP) but our side is ~30–60 min. I'd add a note: require Jordan to provide their IdP admin or grant us a one-time SSO admin link.
Keisha (Support): Customer sentiment notes: Jordan said "we're on the clock" and flagged risk of exploring competitors if this blocks workflows. They are on our Growth plan.
Lina (Customer Success): OK. I'll take primary ownership of the comms and outreach. Planned messages: 1) rapid acknowledgement + workaround offer, 2) confirmation once temp key applied + invite to short verification call, 3) summary and next steps before renewal meeting.
Ethan (Account Exec): Please cc me on all customer comms. I will join verification call if needed.
DevOps Bot: Note: rotation requires secret rotation window. Schedule approval link: https://redwood.internal/ops/inc/INC-4821/approve
Lina (Customer Success): Action items: @Keisha — provide link to incident ticket and paste any additional logs; @Ben — prepare temp key and help run rotation when Ops approves; @Ethan — join customer verification call if available; I'll draft the initial outreach now and send within 30m.
Keisha (Support): Incident link sent in DM to Lina. Logs uploaded to INC-4821.
Ben (Onboarding Eng): Prep done — temp key ready on standby.
Lina (Customer Success): Sending initial note to Jordan now (apology + workaround). Scheduling 15m warm handoff with KitePilot, Keisha, Ben, and Ethan in 30m.
Keisha (Support): Thanks — marking as priority. :thumbsup:
Lina (Customer Success): I'll update the renewal risk tracker after the handoff.
